boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Colby College
boards.description: Late-night dining at Colby College centers on the campus Spa and a select few Waterville staples that keep students fueled during Maine winters and late study sessions.

cards.title: The Spa at Cotter Union
cards.subtitle: The Hub of Late-Night Campus Life
cards.notes: Order a buffalo chicken quesadilla or curly cheese fries at this central campus spot, which serves as the primary late-night gathering point for students until midnight.
cards.short_summary: The Spa is Colby's central late-night dining venue, located in the Cotter Union and known for its grill favorites.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spa offers Late Night hours from 9:00 p.m. to 12:00 a.m. Monday through Friday and until 11:59 p.m. on Saturdays.
cards.source_title: The Spa | Colby Dining - Nutrislice
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on weekdays and Saturdays during the academic year.

cards.title: The Pub at Cotter Union
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Mocktails and Small Bites
cards.notes: Visit the upper level of Cotter Union for a specialty mocktail and wings; all ages are welcome for late-night food pop-ups and social events.
cards.short_summary: Located above the Spa, the Pub offers a distinct late-night menu including quesadillas and wings with an inclusive atmosphere.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pub is open for late-night service until 12:00 a.m. on Thursdays and Fridays, and until 1:00 a.m. on Saturdays, welcoming all ages.
cards.source_title: Weekday “Late Nights” among exciting new developments at the Spa - The Colby Echo
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 a.m. on Saturday nights; under-21 students are permitted.

cards.title: Taco Bell on Main Street
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Drive-Thru Staple
cards.notes: Head downtown for a late-night Crunchwrap; this location is a reliable 24-hour option for students with cars or those using the Colby shuttle.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast food destination located on Main Street, frequently visited by students after campus dining closes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell at 345 Main Street in Waterville is open 24 hours for both dine-in and drive-thru service.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Waterville, ME - 345 Main Street
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily, providing the latest food access in Waterville.

cards.title: McDonald's on Kennedy Memorial Drive
cards.subtitle: Post-Practice Fast Food Run
cards.notes: Stop by for a late-night McFlurry or fries; this location is a common stop for student-athletes returning from late practices or games.
cards.short_summary: A popular fast-food stop located on the main corridor leading to campus, offering late-night drive-thru service.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's at 435 Kennedy Memorial Drive serves as a frequent late-night option for Colby students and athletes.
cards.source_title: Weekday “Late Nights” among exciting new developments at the Spa - The Colby Echo
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru typically remains open late; check seasonal hours for lobby access.

cards.title: Aroma Joe's Coffee
cards.subtitle: All-Nighter Fuel Station
cards.notes: Grab an 'AJ's Rush' energy drink or a large iced coffee to power through a late-night study session at Miller Library.
cards.short_summary: A regional favorite for high-caffeine beverages, located on Kennedy Memorial Drive near the college.
cards.evidence_claim: Aroma Joe's is noted by students as a go-to for high-caffeine drinks during all-nighters.
cards.source_title: The Ultimate Student Guide to Eating and Drinking at Colby College - Spoon University
cards.access_notes: Open early and stays open until 9:00 p.m. or later depending on the day.

cards.title: Cappza's Pizza
cards.subtitle: Local Pizza and Whoopie Pies
cards.notes: Order a late-night pizza delivery or pick up an award-winning Maine whoopie pie for a classic local treat.
cards.short_summary: A local pizza shop on Main Street known for its quality ingredients and traditional Maine desserts.
cards.evidence_claim: Cappza's Pizza is open until 9:00 p.m. daily and offers delivery to the Colby campus.
cards.source_title: Contact - Cappza's Pizza
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 p.m. seven days a week; delivery available.

cards.title: Governor's Restaurant
cards.subtitle: Maine Comfort Food Tradition
cards.notes: Visit for a late dinner of Maine comfort food or a slice of their famous strawberry pie in a classic diner setting.
cards.short_summary: A Maine-based restaurant chain offering wholesome meals and a full bakery, popular for student group dinners.
cards.evidence_claim: Governor's Restaurant in Waterville is a local tradition serving breakfast, dinner, and desserts.
cards.source_title: Locations - Governor's Restaurant & Bakery
cards.access_notes: Check website for current daily closing hours, typically 8:00 p.m. or 9:00 p.m.

cards.title: Applebee's on KMD
cards.subtitle: Late-Night Half-Price Appetizers
cards.notes: Gather with friends for half-price appetizers late at night; it's a standard off-campus destination for large student groups.
cards.short_summary: A familiar chain restaurant on Kennedy Memorial Drive that serves as a late-night social spot for students.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waterville Applebee's is open until 11:00 p.m. Sunday-Thursday and 12:00 a.m. Friday-Saturday.
cards.source_title: Applebee's Grill + Bar Restaurant in Waterville, ME
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight on weekends; under-21 safe for dining.

cards.title: Dunkin' on Main Street
cards.subtitle: Early Morning or Late Evening Coffee
cards.notes: Pick up a box of Munchkins or a late-evening coffee at this downtown location near the Alfond Main Street Commons.
cards.short_summary: A convenient coffee and donut stop for students living in or visiting downtown Waterville.
cards.evidence_claim: The Dunkin' at 339 Main Street is open daily until 9:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: Dunkin' at 339 Main St in Waterville
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:00 p.m. daily; features a drive-thru.

cards.title: Foss 'Comfort' Dining
cards.subtitle: Evening Comfort Food Destination
cards.notes: Visit Foss for a consistent evening menu of pizza, burgers, and pasta, serving as the campus 'comfort' food hub.
cards.short_summary: Foss Dining Hall was recently transitioned to a comfort-food-themed hall to meet student demand for evening favorites.
cards.evidence_claim: Foss Dining Hall specializes in comfort foods like pizza and burgers to increase student participation.
cards.source_title: Your Food, Your Voice - The Colby Echo
cards.access_notes: Standard dinner hours apply; check Nutrislice for daily closing times.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, late-night hubs, and quiet retreats that Colby students use to navigate daily life on Mayflower Hill.

cards.title: The Street at Miller Library
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Hub
cards.notes: Head to the lowest level of Miller Library for 24-hour access to group and individual study spaces, ideal for late-night academic sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study area located on the lowest level of Miller Library featuring group and individual workspaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The lowest level of Miller, known as “The Street,” features individual and group study spaces and is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: About - Colby College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students with valid Colby Card access.

cards.title: Miller Library Reading Garden
cards.subtitle: Third Floor Quiet Retreat
cards.notes: Visit the third floor for comfortable seating, indoor plants, and a dedicated nap pod designed for student recharging.
cards.short_summary: A quiet third-floor space in Miller Library with plants, comfortable seating, and a nap pod.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of Miller Library offers many options including the Reading Garden! The space also offers a Nap Pod which gives students and staff the opportunity to recharge.
cards.source_title: Study spaces in Miller and the third floor Reading Garden
cards.access_notes: Accessible during standard library hours; the third floor is a student-enforced quiet zone.

cards.title: The Pugh Center
cards.subtitle: 24/7 Multicultural Space
cards.notes: Located in Cotter Union, this inclusive space offers couches and a 24/7 schedule for students to study or relax.
cards.short_summary: A multicultural center in Cotter Union providing a 24/7 safe space for student clubs and individual relaxation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pugh Center is open twenty-four hours a day, seven days a week (even when the rest of Pulver is closed).
cards.source_title: The Pugh Center: When Safety is Shattered
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students; located within the Cotter Union building.

cards.title: Bixler Art and Music Library
cards.subtitle: Natural Light Study Area
cards.notes: Use the large windows and media lab in Bixler for a bright, uplifting study environment away from the main library crowds.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library in the Bixler Art and Music Center featuring natural light and a digital media lab.
cards.evidence_claim: Bixler Art and Music Library features... a digital media lab... the windows in Bixler allow for light to stream in and make the study space feel very uplifting.
cards.source_title: Library Study Spaces - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during academic hours; check library website for seasonal changes.

cards.title: Olin Science Center Shared Corridor
cards.subtitle: Active Learning Nooks
cards.notes: Find small group meeting areas and private study spots in the renovated corridors of the Olin Science Center.
cards.short_summary: Renovated hallway spaces in the Olin Science Center designed for small group collaboration and private study.
cards.evidence_claim: The new classroom space... now offers areas for small group meetings or private study in the shared corridor.
cards.source_title: Olin Auditorium & Classroom Renovations - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; typically used for science-focused study.

cards.title: Mary Low Coffeehouse
cards.subtitle: Student-Run Social Space
cards.notes: Visit this student-run venue for a relaxed atmosphere, social study sessions, and occasional evening events.
cards.short_summary: A social coffeehouse located in Mary Low Hall used for student events and informal gatherings.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mary Low Coffeehouse... Events in the Mary Low Coffeehouse can be booked by emailing MLCH@colby.edu.
cards.source_title: Venues and Lodging | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Check student postings for current operating hours and event schedules.

cards.title: Johnson Pond
cards.subtitle: Winter Recreation Spot
cards.notes: Borrow skates from the Alfond Athletics Center to join the local tradition of ice skating on the frozen pond during Jan Plan.
cards.short_summary: An iconic campus pond that serves as a hub for outdoor ice skating during the winter months.
cards.evidence_claim: Students began to beeline for the recreation office... where 50 pairs of skates are housed and available for students to check out... for skating on Johnson Pond.
cards.source_title: Thriving In Winter - Johnson Pond - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Skating is seasonal and dependent on ice thickness; skates available for checkout at the athletic center.

cards.title: Rose Chapel Study Room
cards.subtitle: Quiet Meditation and Study
cards.notes: Find the quiet room just off the Rose Chapel for a peaceful study environment with comfortable couch seating.
cards.short_summary: A quiet room adjacent to the Rose Chapel in Lorimer Chapel used for meditation and silent study.
cards.evidence_claim: Just to the left of the main chapel... there's a nice room just off the Rose Chapel. It's always quiet and there's a lovely couch.
cards.source_title: Hot Study Spots Around Colby | The Odyssey Online
cards.access_notes: Located within Lorimer Chapel; accessible during building hours.

cards.title: Diamond Building Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Social Science Study Nooks
cards.notes: Utilize the open study areas and book drops on the second floor of the Diamond Building for a change of scenery.
cards.short_summary: Study areas located on the second floor of the Diamond Building, home to social science departments.
cards.evidence_claim: We have five convenient book drops located around campus: ... Diamond Building second floor.
cards.source_title: Services - Colby College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Accessible during academic building hours.

cards.title: Mule Works Innovation Lab
cards.subtitle: Makerspace in Miller Library
cards.notes: Access 3D printers and laser cutters in this innovation hub located within Miller Library for creative projects.
cards.short_summary: A campus makerspace featuring advanced fabrication tools like laser cutters and 3D scanners.
cards.evidence_claim: Colby's Mule Works Innovation Lab in Miller Library... is equipped with a Pro Series Full Spectrum Laser Cutter and a 3D scanner and printer.
cards.source_title: Facilities | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Located within Miller Library; some equipment may require training or supervision.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Discover free social activities and public spaces at Colby College, from world-class art galleries to extensive nature trails and community hubs.

cards.title: Colby College Museum of Art
cards.subtitle: Free Admission Art Museum
cards.notes: Explore one of the nation's premier college art museums for free. It features a vast collection of American art and rotating contemporary exhibitions open to the public.
cards.short_summary: A high-caliber art museum on campus offering free admission to all visitors.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colby College Museum of Art is always free and open to all.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Colby Museum
cards.access_notes: Open Tuesday through Saturday 10 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Sunday 12 p.m. to 5 p.m.

cards.title: Perkins Arboretum
cards.subtitle: Nature Trails and Bird Watching
cards.notes: Walk through miles of blazed footpaths and boardwalks. This 128-acre preserve is ideal for bird watching and quiet reflection along Perkins Stream.
cards.short_summary: A large on-campus nature preserve with extensive trails for walking and running.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins Arboretum and Bird Sanctuary is a preserve adjacent to the campus... most of the trails are narrow footpaths.
cards.source_title: Colby College trails - Maine by Foot
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for walking, running, and cross-country skiing.

cards.title: The Street at Miller Library
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study and Social Space
cards.notes: Head to the lowest level of Miller Library for a 24-hour social study space. It features group tables and individual carrels for late-night academic sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour accessible study and social hub located on the lower level of Miller Library.
cards.evidence_claim: The lowest level of Miller, known as “The Street,” features individual and group study spaces and is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Libraries | Colby College
cards.access_notes: The Street level is open 24 hours daily for students.

cards.title: Skating on Johnson Pond
cards.subtitle: Winter Outdoor Recreation
cards.notes: Bring your skates to Johnson Pond during the winter months. This scenic spot behind campus is a classic location for outdoor ice skating and pond hockey.
cards.short_summary: A traditional winter activity where students and locals skate on the frozen campus pond.
cards.evidence_claim: Students also enjoy skating on Johnson Pond (behind campus), snowshoeing, sledding, etc.
cards.source_title: A few questions about Colby - College Confidential Forums
cards.access_notes: Weather dependent; typically available during peak winter months.

cards.title: Greene Block + Studios
cards.subtitle: Downtown Arts Programming
cards.notes: Visit this downtown Waterville hub for free arts programming and exhibitions. The first floor is open to the public and hosts various creative events.
cards.short_summary: A Colby-owned downtown arts center offering free public programming and maker spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: 1st Floor – Multidisciplinary arts programming that is free and open to the public.
cards.source_title: Greene Block + Studios - Colby Arts
cards.access_notes: Located at 18 Main Street, Waterville. Check website for specific event hours.

cards.title: Pulver Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Student Union Social Hub
cards.notes: Relax in the large open seating area of Cotter Union. It's a central spot for meeting friends, people-watching, or catching informal campus performances.
cards.short_summary: The main social gathering space within the Cotter Union student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Cotter Union foot traffic makes this a very visible location... Large open space; Seating capacity: 113.
cards.source_title: Cotter Union 120 (Pulver Pavilion) - TeamDynamix
cards.access_notes: Open daily during student union operating hours.

cards.title: Runnals Hill
cards.subtitle: Scenic Views and Stargazing
cards.notes: Walk to the top of Runnals Hill for panoramic views of Waterville. It's a popular spot for watching sunsets or visiting the organic garden and observatory.
cards.short_summary: A high point on campus offering scenic vistas and access to the college observatory.
cards.evidence_claim: At the top is Colby's observatory and organic garden, and views over the city.
cards.source_title: Colby College trails - Maine by Foot
cards.access_notes: Accessible via campus trails; best visited during daylight or for scheduled observatory events.

cards.title: Music at Colby Concerts
cards.subtitle: Free Student and Faculty Recitals
cards.notes: Attend high-quality musical performances at the Gordon Center. Most student recitals and ensemble concerts are free, though some require advance reservations.
cards.short_summary: A series of free musical performances held in the campus's premier performing arts venue.
cards.evidence_claim: For each event, seats can be reserved a month in advance... Reserve free tickets.
cards.source_title: Upcoming Events | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Check the Colby Arts calendar for free ticket reservations.

cards.title: Diamond Building Atrium
cards.subtitle: Modern Social and Study Space
cards.notes: Gather in the light-filled atrium of the Diamond Building. It's a popular spot for student research presentations and informal group meetings between classes.
cards.short_summary: A bright, modern architectural space used for both study and campus events.
cards.evidence_claim: Go to the Diamond Atrium and stop by the Information table... Oral presentation sessions... Diamond.
cards.source_title: How to Navigate CLAS: Guide for Attendees - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; card access may be required after hours.

cards.title: Athletic Complex Trails
cards.subtitle: Wooded Walking Paths
cards.notes: Explore the easy 0.8-mile trail winding through birch and maple forests behind the athletic fields. It's a quiet escape very close to the main campus facilities.
cards.short_summary: A short, accessible trail system located behind the college's athletic facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Athletic Complex trail is just under one mile, offering a short, easy trail that winds through a forest... Fees: No.
cards.source_title: Colby College - Athletic Complex - Maine Trail Finder
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; hikers not permitted when trails are groomed for skiing in winter.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover ten distinct study environments across the Colby College campus, from the 24-hour 'Street' in Miller Library to the light-filled forums of the Gordon Center.

cards.title: The Street at Miller Library
cards.subtitle: 24-Hour Study Hub
cards.notes: Head to the lowest level of Miller Library for 24-hour access to individual and group study spaces, ideal for late-night sessions.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour study area located on the lowest level of Miller Library featuring diverse seating for individuals and groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The lowest level of Miller, known as “The Street,” features individual and group study spaces and is open 24 hours daily.
cards.source_title: Libraries | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours daily for students.

cards.title: Brewster Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Classic Academic Atmosphere
cards.notes: Visit the first floor of Miller Library to study in this traditional reading room designed for quiet, focused academic work.
cards.short_summary: A traditional quiet reading room located on the first floor of the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Miller Library's Brewster Reading Room is highlighted as a key study space on the first floor.
cards.source_title: Services - Colby College Libraries
cards.access_notes: Available during standard library hours.

cards.title: Olin Science Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet Science Hub
cards.notes: Enter through the potted plants to find large study carrels and group rooms in this quiet library dedicated to the sciences.
cards.short_summary: A quiet library space in the Olin Science Center featuring study carrels and group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Olin is the science library on campus featuring large study carrels, tables for group work, and group study rooms.
cards.source_title: Library Study Spaces - Her Campus
cards.access_notes: Open during posted library hours; quieter alternative to Miller.

cards.title: Bixler Art and Music Library
cards.subtitle: Sunlit Creative Space
cards.notes: Utilize the digital media lab or find a table near the large windows for a bright, uplifting study environment in Bixler.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for art and music featuring a digital media lab and sunlit study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: Bixler Art and Music Library features a digital media lab and study spaces with windows that allow for natural light.
cards.source_title: Libraries | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open during library hours; houses the digital media lab.

cards.title: Pulver Pavilion
cards.subtitle: Social Study Commons
cards.notes: Find informal seating for 113 people in this central student hub, located near the Spa snack bar in Cotter Union.
cards.short_summary: A large, informal study and social space located within the Cotter Union student center.
cards.evidence_claim: Pulver Pavilion features a variety of informal spaces and has a seating capacity of 113.
cards.source_title: The Residential Experience: Student Life and Services | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; high foot traffic area near dining and the bookstore.

cards.title: Olentine Forum
cards.subtitle: Modern Arts Hub
cards.notes: Study in the light-filled forum of the Gordon Center, a hub for student interaction connecting the building's performance venues.
cards.short_summary: A modern, light-filled student interaction and study space within the Gordon Center for Creative and Performing Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The light-filled Olentine Forum connects the main venues and is a hub for student interaction.
cards.source_title: Colby College - Gordon Center for Creative & Performing Arts
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours for the arts departments.

cards.title: Grossman Hall Social Commons
cards.subtitle: Career-Focused Study Area
cards.notes: Access the career resources library and social commons in this renovated space, also home to the DavisConnects program.
cards.short_summary: A social commons and career resources library located in the renovated Grossman Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: A career resources library and social commons are located in the extension of Grossman Hall.
cards.source_title: Colby College, DavisCONNECTS - Annum Architects
cards.access_notes: Open Monday–Friday, 8 a.m. – 5 p.m.

cards.title: Diamond Building TEAL Rooms
cards.subtitle: Collaborative Tech Spaces
cards.notes: Use the breakout areas and large monitors in Technology-Enabled Active Learning (TEAL) rooms for group projects and screen sharing.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative classrooms in the Diamond Building equipped with breakout stations and monitors for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: TEAL classrooms include breakout areas with large monitors for students to work together in groups.
cards.source_title: Diamond 122 | Academic Technology Services
cards.access_notes: Available when classes are not in session; features movable furniture.

cards.title: Greene Block + Studios
cards.subtitle: Downtown Arts Space
cards.notes: Study in the heart of downtown Waterville at this multidisciplinary arts space featuring a book and print makerspace.
cards.short_summary: A multidisciplinary arts programming space in downtown Waterville with public study and makerspace areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The 1st floor features multidisciplinary arts programming and a book and print makerspace open to the public.
cards.source_title: Greene Block + Studios - Colby Arts
cards.access_notes: Located at 18 Main Street; check website for current public hours.

cards.title: Johnson Pond Outdoor Area
cards.subtitle: Scenic Outdoor Study
cards.notes: Grab an Adirondack chair by the water for a peaceful outdoor study session with views of the campus's most iconic landmark.
cards.short_summary: A scenic outdoor area by Johnson Pond featuring Adirondack chairs for quiet reading and study.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnson Pond is described as a quiet spot with Adirondack chairs available for sitting and reading.
cards.source_title: A quiet spot by Johnson Pond - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Best during daylight hours in fair weather.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the revitalized corridors of downtown Waterville, where Colby College's civic investments have created a vibrant extension of campus life just two miles from Mayflower Hill.

cards.title: The Heart of Downtown
cards.subtitle: Main Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this central corridor to visit the Schupf Arts Center and local boutiques that define the city's recent revitalization.
cards.short_summary: The primary commercial and cultural artery of downtown Waterville, heavily revitalized by Colby College investments.
cards.evidence_claim: Colby's downtown revitalization efforts have totaled approximately $85 million, including the Paul J. Schupf Art Center and Lockwood Hotel on Main Street.
cards.source_title: The Revitalization of Downtown Waterville - Colby News
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare accessible 24/7; business hours vary by establishment.

cards.title: Civic Engagement Hub
cards.subtitle: Main Street at Temple Street
cards.notes: Visit the ground-floor community forum where students and locals gather for public meetings and collaborative events.
cards.short_summary: A mixed-use residential and community building housing 200 Colby students and faculty in the heart of downtown.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bill & Joan Alfond Main Street Commons is a living and learning community that offers apartment-style residences for 200 Colby students and faculty.
cards.source_title: Life at Colby - Alfond Commons
cards.access_notes: Ground floor community forum is open to the public during scheduled events.

cards.title: Community Gathering Green
cards.subtitle: Common Street at Main Street
cards.notes: Attend seasonal festivals and outdoor art workshops in this historic park located adjacent to City Hall.
cards.short_summary: A central public square used for community events, festivals, and the annual Parade of Lights.
cards.evidence_claim: Castonguay Square hosts events like the Maine Fermentation Festival and Art in the Park, a collaboration with the Colby College Museum of Art.
cards.source_title: Festivals & Events | Waterville, ME
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Arts and Innovation Space
cards.subtitle: Main Street at Appleton Street
cards.notes: Explore the fourth-floor innovation incubator where students develop entrepreneurial projects late into the night.
cards.short_summary: A renovated historic building providing studio space for artists and an innovation hub for Colby students.
cards.evidence_claim: The $6.5-million Greene Block + Studios includes ground-level retail and upper-level student innovation incubator programs.
cards.source_title: Colby's first Waterville downtown development piece is in place
cards.access_notes: Student incubator space accessible late night for authorized students; public areas open during business hours.

cards.title: The Downtown Plaza
cards.subtitle: Between Main and Elm Streets
cards.notes: Visit the weekly farmers market during warmer months to find local Maine produce and handmade goods.
cards.short_summary: A large open-air commercial plaza and parking area that serves as a site for community markets and retail.
cards.evidence_claim: The Concourse is where the farmers market sets up weekly during warmer weather and is bordered by Main, Appleton, and Temple streets.
cards.source_title: Colby Looking to Build a Dorm on the Concourse in Waterville
cards.access_notes: Public plaza accessible 24/7; Farmers Market typically held on Thursdays.

cards.title: Historic Elm Street Anchor
cards.subtitle: Elm Street Corridor
cards.notes: Study in the Bartlett Room for Teens or attend a 'Crafternoon' session in this Carnegie-funded library.
cards.short_summary: A historic public library on Elm Street providing extensive resources and community programming for all ages.
cards.evidence_claim: The Waterville Public Library at 73 Elm Street offers programs like 'Crafternoons' and a dedicated Bartlett Room for Teens.
cards.source_title: Waterville Public Library - Home
cards.access_notes: Open Mon, Wed-Fri 10am-5pm; Tue 10am-7pm; Sat 10am-3pm.

cards.title: Kennebec Riverfront Park
cards.subtitle: Front Street District
cards.notes: Walk the scenic path along the Kennebec River and view the historic Ticonic Falls from the gazebo.
cards.short_summary: A scenic waterfront park and walking trail located on the site of Waterville's historic industrial roots.
cards.evidence_claim: The RiverWalk at Head of Falls is a park along the Kennebec River in one of Waterville's most important historic districts.
cards.source_title: Connecting with Waterville and Maine - Colby College Admissions
cards.access_notes: Public park open daily from dawn to dusk.

cards.title: Dining and Local Flavor
cards.subtitle: Silver Street Corridor
cards.notes: Explore the southern end of downtown to find local cafes and restaurants popular with the student community.
cards.short_summary: A historic street known for its concentration of local dining establishments and proximity to the Kennebec River.
cards.evidence_claim: The downtown district, including Silver Street, has many restaurants, shopping areas, and student-friendly cafés.
cards.source_title: Waterville, Maine: A Welcoming Community - Thomas College
cards.access_notes: Public street; restaurant hours vary.

cards.title: The Downtown Connector
cards.subtitle: Appleton Street Corridor
cards.notes: Use this pedestrian-friendly link to move between the Public Library on Elm Street and the Alfond Commons on Main.
cards.short_summary: A key east-west connector in downtown Waterville linking major civic and residential hubs.
cards.evidence_claim: Appleton Street is an important downtown connector, linking Elm Street to the Waterville Public Library and Main Street.
cards.source_title: Appleton Street Vision Project - Waterville, ME
cards.access_notes: Public street with ongoing pedestrian improvements.

cards.title: Gateway to the Arts
cards.subtitle: Temple Street Corridor
cards.notes: Walk past the modern glass facades of the Alfond Commons to reach the Maine Film Center for independent screenings.
cards.short_summary: A street defining the northern edge of the Alfond Commons and providing access to major downtown arts venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The 100,000-square-foot Alfond Commons is seen from Temple Street and serves as a gateway to downtown arts programming.
cards.source_title: Colby's first Waterville downtown development piece is in place
cards.access_notes: Public street; arts center hours vary by performance schedule.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Discover the unique rituals and long-standing traditions that define the student experience at Colby College, from sunrise gatherings to wilderness adventures.

cards.title: The Doghead Sunrise
cards.subtitle: A St. Patrick's Day All-Nighter
cards.notes: Stay awake all night on the Friday before St. Patrick's Day to watch the sunrise from the Miller Library steps with the entire campus community.
cards.short_summary: An annual all-night celebration culminating in a communal sunrise gathering at the campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Every year, on the Friday before St. Patrick's Day, students stay up all night to watch the sunrise over Miller Lawn, a tradition known as Doghead.
cards.source_title: Doghead returns for another year at Colby
cards.access_notes: Requires student registration and wristbands for security; events run through the night until 7:00 AM.

cards.title: COOT Wilderness Trips
cards.subtitle: Colby Outdoor Orientation Trips
cards.notes: Bond with your 'COOT family' during a multi-day outdoor adventure in the Maine wilderness before your first semester officially begins.
cards.short_summary: A mandatory outdoor orientation program for first-year students involving camping, hiking, and group bonding.
cards.evidence_claim: COOT (Colby Outdoor Orientation Trip) is a program where incoming students participate in outdoor activities like backpacking and canoeing over Labor Day Weekend.
cards.source_title: Life at Colby - COOT
cards.access_notes: Mandatory for first-year students; involves travel to various Maine wilderness locations.

cards.title: Rings Under the Blue Light
cards.subtitle: A Miller Library Tower Ritual
cards.notes: Leave your class ring overnight under the blue light atop Miller Library's tower to connect with generations of Colby alumni.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where seniors leave their class rings in the library tower overnight to be 'blessed' by the campus beacon.
cards.evidence_claim: Seniors leave their class rings under the blue light in the Miller Library tower overnight, and they are returned the next day.
cards.source_title: Colby Alumni and Families - Blue Light Tradition
cards.access_notes: Occurs during Senior Week; access to the tower is typically restricted to these specific events.

cards.title: The White Mule Mascot
cards.subtitle: Colby's Unconventional Symbol
cards.notes: Celebrate Morty the Mule, a mascot chosen in 1923 to represent the 'antithesis of the dark horse' in athletic competitions.
cards.short_summary: The official mascot of Colby College, symbolizing the school's underdog spirit and resilience.
cards.evidence_claim: The mule became Colby's mascot in 1923 after an editorial in the Colby Echo proposed it as a replacement for the 'dark horse' label.
cards.source_title: Making of the Mule: How Colby's Mascot Came to Life
cards.access_notes: Morty appears at varsity athletic games and major campus events throughout the year.

cards.title: Loudness Weekends
cards.subtitle: Semester Kickoff and Finale
cards.notes: Participate in 'Loudness,' the themed campus-wide celebrations held during the first and last weekends of every academic semester.
cards.short_summary: Traditional campus-wide social events that mark the beginning and end of each college term.
cards.evidence_claim: The first and last weekends of each semester are known as 'Loudness,' which are themed, campus-wide party events.
cards.source_title: Colby parties? - College Confidential
cards.access_notes: Events are held across various residential halls and campus social spaces.

cards.title: Ringing the Victory Bell
cards.subtitle: A Post-Game Celebration
cards.notes: Head to Roberts Union to ring the campus bell after the first home football victory of the season, a rare and celebrated sound.
cards.short_summary: A victory ritual where students ring the bell at Roberts Union following significant athletic wins.
cards.evidence_claim: The bell in Roberts Union is rung for the first time each year after the first home football victory.
cards.source_title: Long-standing traditions for undergraduates at Colby College
cards.access_notes: The bell is located at Roberts Union and is accessible to students after home game victories.

cards.title: The Baccalaureate Procession
cards.subtitle: Commencement Weekend Kickoff
cards.notes: Join the graduating class for a reflective ceremony in Lorimer Chapel, a tradition of humility and community that precedes formal commencement.
cards.short_summary: A solemn and reflective graduation tradition held in the campus chapel for the senior class.
cards.evidence_claim: Colby's Baccalaureate ceremony is a long-standing tradition held during graduation weekend, often featuring themes of community and kindness.
cards.source_title: Colby's 205th Baccalaureate
cards.access_notes: Held annually in May; primarily for graduating seniors and their families.

cards.title: The Colby Carnival
cards.subtitle: Winter Sports Tradition
cards.notes: Cheer on the Mules at Sugarloaf Mountain during this annual winter tradition featuring alpine and nordic ski competitions.
cards.short_summary: A major winter event centered around intercollegiate ski racing and campus-wide winter festivities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colby Carnival is an annual winter event featuring alpine and nordic skiing competitions, often held at Sugarloaf.
cards.source_title: Skiing Begins 2026 Alpine Season at Colby Carnival
cards.access_notes: Spectators are welcome at the ski events; requires travel to Carrabassett Valley.

cards.title: The Jan Plan
cards.subtitle: One Month, One Subject
cards.notes: Immerse yourself in a single intensive course, internship, or research project during the unique four-week January term.
cards.short_summary: A signature academic tradition where students focus on a single intensive experience during the month of January.
cards.evidence_claim: Jan Plan is a guaranteed experience for every Colby student, allowing for intensive study, internships, or travel abroad in January.
cards.source_title: Long-standing traditions for undergraduates at Colby College
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually during the month of January; part of the standard academic calendar.

cards.title: The Condon Medal
cards.subtitle: Highest Student Honor
cards.notes: Witness the awarding of the Condon Medal, the only award presented at commencement, given to the senior who best exemplifies citizenship.
cards.short_summary: The most prestigious award given to a graduating senior, voted on by both the senior class and faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: The Condon Medal is a prestigious honor at Colby, awarded to a senior who is deeply committed to community and citizenship.
cards.source_title: Seniors Encouraged to Embrace Imperfections
cards.access_notes: Announced and presented during Commencement weekend in May.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Colby College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Build a plausible under-21-safe first-weekend sequence, not a ranking. Give each card one role in the sequence and use evergreen places or recurring behaviors rather than one-time events. Be conservative about hours, access, and travel time unless directly sourced.

cards.title: Attend the Official Welcome
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Kickoff
cards.notes: Join the formal welcome ceremony on the central green to meet college leadership and your orientation group.
cards.short_summary: The central lawn hosting the formal welcome ceremony for new students and their families.
cards.evidence_claim: The Colby Welcome for the Class of 2025 was held from 4:30–5:15 pm at the tent on Colby Green.
cards.source_title: Orientation - Life at Colby - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open public space; orientation events are mandatory for first-year students.

cards.title: Dinner with Your O-Group
cards.subtitle: Friday Evening Social
cards.notes: Head to 'Bobs' for your first group dinner to start building connections with your new classmates.
cards.short_summary: A primary campus dining hall, colloquially known as 'Bobs,' serving local Maine-sourced meals.
cards.evidence_claim: Orientation schedules include dinner with Orientation Groups (O Groups) at campus dining halls like Roberts.
cards.source_title: Sustainable Dining | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Requires student ID/meal plan for entry; open during standard academic meal hours.

cards.title: Find Your 24-Hour Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Late Night Friday
cards.notes: Explore the lowest level of Miller Library, a 24-hour space perfect for late-night planning or quiet study.
cards.short_summary: The 24-hour accessible lower level of Miller Library featuring individual and group study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The lowest level of Miller Library, known as 'The Street,' is open 24 hours daily for students.
cards.source_title: Libraries | Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 for students with valid Colby ID card access.

cards.entity_name: Harold Alfond Athletics and Recreation Center
cards.title: Tour the Athletic Complex
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Activity
cards.notes: Check out the Olympic-sized pool and fitness center at this massive 350,000-square-foot facility.
cards.short_summary: Colby's premier multi-use athletic facility featuring an ice arena, pool, and fitness center.
cards.evidence_claim: The HAARC is a 350,000-square-foot facility open to students with a valid Colby ID.
cards.source_title: Facility Access and Use - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Valid Colby ID required for entry; check daily hours for specific venue availability.

cards.title: Browse the Galleries
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Culture
cards.notes: Visit the largest museum in Maine to see American art and rotating contemporary exhibitions.
cards.short_summary: A leading teaching museum on campus with a significant collection of American art and free admission.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is free and open to all, with campus hours Tuesday–Saturday 10 a.m.–5 p.m.
cards.source_title: Plan Your Visit - Colby Museum
cards.access_notes: Free admission for all visitors; closed on Mondays.

cards.title: Ride Downtown to Waterville
cards.subtitle: Saturday Evening Transit
cards.notes: Take the free shuttle from campus to downtown Waterville to explore Main Street shops and dining.
cards.short_summary: A free student shuttle service connecting Mayflower Hill with downtown Waterville locations.
cards.evidence_claim: The Mule Express operates daily from 7:30 am to 11:30 pm connecting campus to downtown.
cards.source_title: Transportation - Life at Colby - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Free for Colby students with ID; runs approximately every 60 minutes.

cards.title: Grab a Late Night Snack
cards.subtitle: Saturday Night Social
cards.notes: Visit Cotter Union for late-night food options and a chance to hang out with friends after hours.
cards.short_summary: A central campus dining and social hub located in Cotter Union offering late-night service.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spa offers Late Night hours on Saturdays from 9:00 pm to 11:59 pm.
cards.source_title: Dining Services | Colby College | Home
cards.access_notes: Late-night hours are typically 9 PM to midnight during the academic year.

cards.title: Relax by the Water
cards.subtitle: Sunday Morning Peace
cards.notes: Take a quiet walk around the perimeter of this iconic campus pond, surrounded by weeping willows.
cards.short_summary: A picturesque man-made pond on campus used for relaxation and seasonal skating.
cards.evidence_claim: Johnson Pond is described as an iconic landmark with benches for relaxation and winter skating.
cards.source_title: Thriving In Winter - Johnson Pond - Colby College
cards.access_notes: Open public outdoor area; accessible year-round.

cards.title: Hike the Campus Trails
cards.subtitle: Sunday Afternoon Exploration
cards.notes: Explore the miles of wooded footpaths and see the small waterfall along Perkins Stream.
cards.short_summary: A wildlife sanctuary and trail system adjacent to campus featuring diverse Maine forest terrain.
cards.evidence_claim: The Perkins Arboretum features narrow footpaths and a loop to a waterfall and bridge.
cards.source_title: Colby College trails - Maine by Foot
cards.access_notes: Open to the public for hiking; pets are permitted on trails.

cards.title: Find a Moment of Reflection
cards.subtitle: Sunday Evening Wind-down
cards.notes: Visit this historic brick chapel for a quiet moment before the first week of classes begins.
cards.short_summary: A historic Georgian-style chapel on campus used for services, concerts, and quiet reflection.
cards.evidence_claim: Lorimer Chapel is a central campus landmark listed on the interactive map for various events.
cards.source_title: Colby College Interactive Map
cards.access_notes: Open for scheduled services and as a quiet space during designated hours.
